subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Classifies insects (six legs) and spiders (eight legs); an insect's body has head, thorax and abdomen

show.line: An insect has six legs. A spider has eight legs. Let's count!

rounds.prompt: Count the legs on the ant.
rounds.praise: Six legs! An ant is an insect.

rounds.prompt: Count the legs on the spider.
rounds.praise: Eight legs! A spider is not an insect.

rounds.prompt: How many legs does an insect have?
An insect body has three parts. Tap the insect.
rounds.praise: A beetle! Head, middle and tail end.

hints: Count the legs one by one.
Six legs: insect. Eight legs: spider.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the spider's legs.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A spider has eight legs.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count. A spider has eight legs!

parent_line: Knows insects have six legs and spiders have eight.
